Commentary.Commentary: Okay. One more time. We are ready to begin.

Scratch all that. The players are back on the field. Scratch all that which was scratched any which ways. The players go off again! Boy, this is frustrating. The players had come onto the field, but just when Imam-ul-Haq was taking guard, the drizzle returned and the players were asked to go. Now, the hover cover comes on and ironically, the ground is bathed in sunshine. Virat Kohli sits in the dugout and is having a smile about that.

UPDATE - 3.15 PM LOCAL (1415 GMT) - Ohh the fickle English weather. Plenty of sunshine 5 minutes back, heavily overcast now. It has started to drizzle again and the umpires are heading back. There is a massive patch of dark cloud checking the attendance at Old Trafford and its facilities, whether the ground can take the rain or not and the inspection by this rain cloud might take a while.

Welcome back. No. Go back. We should have started by now, but the heavens have opened up again. Umbrellas are up in the stands and it is coming down pretty heavily. The good news is, only the hover cover is on, so this may not be a big delay. In fact, bright sunshine is now enveloping the ground. Should not be far from the start.
337 to win then. Pakistan faltered chasing 308 against Australia. India's bowling attack is much more penetrating than the Aussies and bowls with much more control. All the best then.

KL Rahul is down for a chat with Michael Clarke. Rahul says that it has been a while since he opened in ODIs and is happy that he could get the team off to a good start. Stresses that given the fact that Pakistan's new-ball bowlers swing the ball a lot, it was a plan to see off the first 10 overs. Admits that he was nervous, but not because it was India-Pakistan but because he had to wait for more than 2 years in the sidelines to feature in the ODI team. On the pitch, Rahul reckons that the pitch will be spiced up by the rain and believes that India's bowlers will do the job. Adds that the track will aid turn and that will help his team even more.

Not the greatest of bowling displays by Pakistan, especially after electing to bowl. They had the conditions in their favour, with the skies overcast but could not make much use of those. And with the ball not swinging around much, they lost patience and started spraying it around. Mohammad Amir continued his resurgence with a 3-wicket haul to follow his 5-fer against Australia. None of the others were impressive. Imad Wasim was economical but he just focused on curtailing the batsmen and did not go for wickets. Hassan Ali endured a torrid outing while Wahab Riaz could not do much.

The impetus was laid by a new opening pair today, with Rohit Sharma and KL Rahul registering a 136-run opening stand. That was followed by a 98-run partnership for the second wicket and at that stage, it looked like 350-360 was on the cards. But Rohit's wicket stalled the runs a little and the new batsmen found it difficult to score runs. Yet another strong show from the Indian top 3, with each crossing 50.

A fine finish by India then to end on 336. The rain break did not hamper them much as there were only 20 balls left. With the rain spicing up the pitch a little, this now adds a new dimension to the total. Earlier, it was a challenging total on a good pitch. Now, it is a daunting task on a quickened track.

No, they can't! Just the single on the last ball. Jadhav dances down the track and Amir bowls it short. KJ mistimes it towards deep cover for one. A decent last over from Amir. 9 from it. INDIA END WITH 336/5!
Full and on middle, Shankar hits it down to long on and takes one. One ball to go, a biggie to get over 340. Can India do so?
WIDE! Just outside the tramline on the off side and it has been wided. A marginal call as Shankar did move across to the off pole.
FOUR! Another welcome boundary for India! This was a delightful stroke. Amir bowls it full and outside off, it is the seam-up ball. Shankar lofts it over covers and the ball goes into the fence.
Another excellent delivery! A very full ball on middle, all Jadhav can do is jam it out towards mid off for one.
Just short! More importantly a dot! Slower one wide outside off, Jadhav swings but gets an outside edge which falls just short of Sarfaraz.

DROPPED! A tough chance! Amir goes full and on middle, Shankar hits it firmly back towards the bowler. Amir jumps and looks to take it with both hands but the ball bursts through and goes down to long on for one.
A single to end! A low full toss outside off, it is hit towards sweeper cover for one. 12 from the over. A good one for India.
A couple now! Wahab goes short again, Shankar looks to pull but gets a top edge which lands in the deep backward square leg region.

OUCH! That might have hurt! A short one and it skids through. Jadhav is very late in the pull. The ball hits the glove and rolls towards mid-wicket for one. The fielder does have a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Over mid off and a boundary! A welcome boundary for India. Full and on off by Riaz. Jadhav nonchalantly lofts it over mid off and bags a boundary. India would love a few more.
Strange! The Ultra Edge is now shown of the Virat Kohli dismissal and it's detecting nothing. India have a referral left but it seems that the Indian skipper also felt that he hit it.
Another wide! Way too wide outside off, left alone.
Full again on off, Shankar mistimes it to cover for a single. Singles are something Pakistan won't mind at the moment.
Slower one outside off, Jadhav guides it down to third man for one.
That has slipped out of Wahab's hand. A full toss outside off, Jadhav fails to put bat on ball. It has been wided.
A single to end! Jadhav guides it down to third man. Another good over for Pakistan. They are once again finishing strongly. Just the 4 runs and a wicket from it.
Back of a length on off, Jadhav guides it to point.
Kedar Jadhav arrives in the middle. He has a strike rate of 102.5 in ODIs and India will love if he gets going from the word go.

OUT! Amir has got the better of Kohli yet again! Another big wicket in the context of the game. This could probably make a difference of at least 20 runs to the final score. Amir bangs it short and it is a quick one. It zips through. Kohli looks to pull but ends up getting a top edge towards the keeper. Amir starts running in celebration and then Kohli has a look at the umpire. Now the bowler turns to see back and umpire Erasmus nods. The Indian skipper is off. Another top innings from him comes to an end but he would have loved to stay there till the end. Two new batsmen out in the middle now with a little more than 2 overs to go.
Shorter and outside off, Kohli slaps it through cover-point and takes two.
Goes very full and on middle, Shankar works it out to mid-wicket and gets to the other end. Sensible from him, he just needs to give the strike over to his skipper at the moment.
A dot! Gold dust at this stage! Length and outside off, Shankar looks to hit it over mid off but misses.

FOUR! Delicate! Lovely from Kohli. Slower one on off, Kohli plays it very late and guides it very fine on the off side and bags a boundary at third man. Sarfaraz is not happy with his bowler. The last ball spoils the over.  9 from it.
WIDE! A slower ball bouncer! Bounces above the batsman's ahead as he tries to pull. Wided.
Goes full around off, Shankar mistimes his shot in the air over covers for a run.

It's time to resume. Virat Kohli and Vijay Shankar are coming down the stairs of the dressing room. They are waiting near the boundary line for the other players to join. Now, the Pakistani players are in the middle. Shankar will be on strike. Wahab Riaz to complete his over. Here we go again...

Update 1428 local (1328 GMT) - Some good news coming in! The drizzle has also stopped and the hover cover is coming off. The two umpires came a little while back to inspect the conditions. There were a few worrisome patches inside the ring but it seems the groundsmen will dry that out quickly. Umpire Marais Erasmus gives a thumbs up to the dressing room of both teams. We are hearing that the match will resume in 12 minutes, i.e. 1440 local (1340 GMT). The mid-innings break will be 15 minutes. Importantly, no overs have been lost.

Update 1407 local (1307 GMT) - The rain has reduced into a drizzle and it's looking a lot brighter than it was a few minutes back. The groundsmen are at work and there is one Super Sopper rolling across the stadium. Still waiting for the official verdict on whether India will come out to bat again or not. Stay tuned, we will keep you posted.

Update 1345 local (1245 GMT) - It's raining now! The players are heading back to the pavilion and the hover cover comes on to protect the playing area. Slowly, slowly more covers are coming on. As soon as Pakistan started to pull things back just a bit, they have to go off. Let's hope that the rain passes away soon and India get to bat their full quota of overs. Stay tuned for more updates...

NOT OUT! A big gap between bat and ball and the on-field call has to be overturned. Good use of the technology by Shankar. This is full and outside off. Shankar looks to hit it through the off side but there is some noise as the ball passes the bat. Sarfaraz takes it and appeals. The umpire raises the finger. Shankar reviews and is looking confident. Replays roll in and they show that the noise was of the bat hitting the ground. Vijay survives to fight another day.

A catch has been taken behind the wickets. The finger goes up after the appeal is made. Vijay Shankar though is very sure that he has not edged it. He takes the DRS and calmly walks up to his captain to have a chat. There was some noise. Maybe, that was of the bat hitting the surface.
Back of a length on the body, Shankar pulls it towards deep square leg for two.
Length and on off, Shankar strokes it to covers.
There is some drizzle in the air now. Virat Kohli is visibly not happy that the umpires are not going off.
Just over! Slower ball and shorter in length outside off, Kohli initially looks to cut but then tries to bail out. The ball though hits the bat and lobs over the point fielder for one.
Wahab Riaz is back!
A dot to end a very good over by Amir. Just the 4 and a wicket from it. Back of a length on off, Shankar guides it to point.
On the body, it is worked through square leg for one.
300 up for India. Short and on middle, Kohli looks to pull but it goes off the bottom towards mid-wicket and the batsmen take two.
Does the smart thing now by guiding it down to third man and giving the strike to Kohli. First run for Shankar in the World Cup.
BEATEN FOR PACE! Length and outside off, Shankar looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
Vijay Shankar is in next. Interesting move to send him ahead of Kedar Jadhav, who has a SR in excess of 100 in ODIs.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! No MS magic today. Amir gets two huge wickets in the last three balls he has bowled. Amir bowls this full and outside off, it is a scrambled seam delivery. There is a little extra bounce as well. Dhoni swings but the ball kisses the outside edge and goes into the gloves of the keeper. 350 now looks a tough task with Dhoni gone.

A single to end the over. He has already conceded the most runs by a Pakistan bowler in a World Cup game. Back of a length around off, Dhoni guides it down to third man for one. 12 from the over again and Hassan has gone for 84 in the 9 overs he has bowled.
11 from the 5 balls bowled! Kohli pushes this through covers and takes one.
Shorter in length and on middle, Kohli pulls it through mid-wicket and takes two. So a dot to start the over but 10 from the next three balls.
FOUR! Another poor ball and Hassan pays the price again. Down the leg side, Kohli works it fine, finer than the last ball and a boundary results again.
FOUR! 11000 ODI runs for Virat Kohli. He is the fastest to do so and he gets that milestone up in style. He receives a ball down the leg side and just flicks it to the fine leg fence.
On off, it is pushed to cover.
Slower one on middle, Kohli pushes it down to long off for one. A wicket but 12 from it.
Here comes the inventor of the Helicopter shot - Mahendra Singh Dhoni. The crowd has gone bonkers seeing him coming down the stairs. Can he put on a show?

OUT! In the air... taken! Pandya holes out. Amir has the last laugh. This is full and on middle, Pandya brings out the helicopter shot. Does not get the power he needed to clear the ropes behind and it goes towards wide long on where Azam takes it over his head. A decent cameo from him comes to an end. Pakistan will be relieved to see his back.
FOUR! Slapped! Another outstanding shot! Slower one and on off, Pandya stands tall and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Make that 7 as Kohli chops this towards point for a quick run.
FOUR! Dismissed! Brute! Full and on off, Kohli shuffles across and smashes it through mid off. 6 from the first two balls.
Brilliant running again! Also, Kohli brings his 51st ODI fifty. Consecutive fifties for him and it is another top knock. He gets there by working it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Mohammad Amir is back! He was exceptional in his first spell and will have to be at his best at the death.
Now a couple! 13 from the over. Slower one and shorter in length. This is pulled gently towards mid-wicket for two.
A dot! Quick and outside off, Pandya is late in the cut shot.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! A high full toss on the pads, Pandya says thank you very much and whips it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Lovely bowling! Another slower one outside off, Pandya does not pick it again and is way too early into the shot. Misses and it goes closely past the off pole.

SIX! That has gone off the top edge! Outrageous. Speaks volumes about the quality of the bat now-a-days. Also, it was a slower one outside off, Pandya is completely foxed. He is way too early into the slog. The ball goes off the top edge and clears the third man fence.
Slower one on off, Kohli drops it towards point and gets to the other end.
A single to end as Kohli works it through square leg and gets to the other end. So despite the boundary early on, only 7 from the over.
On middle, Kohli hits it back to the bowler.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Goes short and outside off, Pandya looks to pull but the ball rushes onto him and it ends up going to mid off.
Now cleverly guides it down to third man and takes one.

FOUR! Not the best start for him but the perfect start to the over for India. Full and on off, easy pickings with mid off up. Kohli lofts it over that fielder and bags a boundary. Pressure on the bowler.
Wahab Riaz is back into the attack. He has been very good at the death for Pakistan. They will need him to finish well here.
Good running again! Slower one on middle, Pandya works it with soft hands towards mid-wicket. The weight on the shot is perfect so two taken. Still only 6 from the over. Pakistan will take that.
Another very full ball, difficult to get under those. Kohli hits it to long on and takes one.
Very full on the pads again, Pandya flicks it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
Short of the keeper! Slower one and outside off, Pandya slashes but the ball takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to Ahmed.
Very full on the pads, Kohli works it towards fine leg for one. 250 up.
Very full on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.

Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Maximum of 5 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings. We are into the final 10 overs of this Indian innings. With the likes of Pandya and Kohli at the crease and Dhoni - The Finisher yet to come, Pakistan are staring at a total around 350, if not more, unless they lift their bowling.
Another misfield! This is pushed towards long on where the fielder runs to his right but does not stop the ball cleanly. Two taken.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
BEATEN! Floats it up on off, Pandya looks to drive it through the off side but is beaten by the away turn.
This is guided towards short third man for one.
Misfield and another run! Shorter and on off, Kohli slaps it towards cover. They take one. The fielder fumbles and they run another.
FOUR! Welcome back into the attack, Khan. Short and on middle, Kohli goes back and pulls it in the vacant mid-wicket region and bags a boundary.
Shadab Khan is back on!
Short and outside off, Pandya tries to cut but misses. End of a successful over from Hassan.
On the pads, Pandya flicks it in the gap at mid-wicket and calls for two. Completes it with ease.
Short in length and outside off, Hardik cuts it powerfully and it races away. The sweeper cuts it off at the very last moment and saves two for his team.
Pandya defends it from within the crease.
Hardik Pandya is the new man in. He can add to Pakistan's misery here. If he gets in, Pakistan will have to bid this game goodbye.

OUT! Rohit Sharma is gone! No double century this time. Tries to be cheeky and that brings his downfall! Hassan delivers it on a length outside off and Rohit shuffles across the stumps with the intention of spooning it over short fine leg. But he doesn't get the desired connection and Wahab Riaz takes a simple catch inside the ring. Sharma is gutted with himself. He wanted to get his fourth double ton at the grandest stage. Anyway, a handsome knock by The Hitman and he walks back to a standing ovation. End of a 98-run stand, Pakistan have an opening here but they will have to deal with the likes of Pandya and Dhoni now.
FOUR! Hassan is a marked man! Starts his new spell with a short ball and Rohit pulls it without any issue over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Change in bowling. Hassan Ali returns. He has been very expensive in his first 5 overs, conceding 45. Time for redemption?
A quick single to end! Full and on middle, Rohit strokes it towards mid on.
Lovely shot! Stays leg side to the delivery and manages to guide it through backward point. Third man gets across to his right and keeps it down to two.
A little too straight again, Kohli looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg. Leg bye taken.
On the bounce! Goes short again and on the body, Rohit pulls it uppishly but on the bounce to fine leg. One run.
FOUR! If you bowl short to Sharma, you will be punished. Short and on the body, Rohit swivels and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Length and on off, Kohli plays it late down to third man for one.
A single to end! 5 from the over. Kohli hits this one down to long on and gets to the other end. End of Imad Wasim with the ball for tonight. Not bad figures for him. He finishes with 10-0-49-0.
Rohit dances down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He strokes it to long off for one.
Floated up on off, Kohli hits it wide of long off and a run is taken.
Shorter and on off, Rohit guides it through point for one.
Very full on the pads, this is whipped down to long on for one.
On off, Kohli guides it to short third man.

Drinks break. India are motoring! They are looking to bat Pakistan out of this game. 14 overs to go and the Men in Blue have two set batsmen in middle. Rohit Sharma is going great guns and Virat Kohli is playing the supporting role superbly. With the firepower left in the Indian batting order, they will be targeting a total close to 350, if not more. Pakistan have been very clueless in the field. They usually do well in the death overs and that's what Sarfaraz will be banking on at the moment. Whatever happens, we are in for a treat.
Another single to end! This is on the pads, it is worked to fine leg for one. 24 from the last 3 overs and that too without any risk taken.
Plays this one late and guides it down to third man for one.
Now a couple! Too easy at the moment for India. This is worked through mid-wicket and the batters take two.
FOUR! Up and over! Slower one and it is short and outside off, Rohit cuts it over point and it races to the fence.
Back of a length on off, Rohit pushes it to covers.
Pacey ball! Short and hurries onto Kohli. He looks to pull but the ball hits the gloves and rolls towards the leg side for one.
Wahab Riaz is brought back on! Can he provide the much-needed breakthrough here? This pair is wearing a very dangerous look at the moment.
A dot to end! So despite the boundary, just 7 from the over. Rohit pushes this to the right of the bowler who gets there and saves a run.
EDGED AND FOUR! No slip in place! Imad lands this on off, it straightens. Rohit looks to push at it but ends up playing inside the line. The ball goes off the outside edge and to the third man fence.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
Easy two! Rohit works it wide of deep square leg and takes a brace.
Flighted on off, Kohli strokes it towards cover where the fielder gets a hand to it and deflects it towards long off. One taken. 200 up for India.
On off, defended.
A couple to end another good over for India. Rohit pushes this wide of long on and takes two. 8 from the over, Shadab continues to prove expensive.
FOUR! That went to the fence in a jiffy. Rohit plays the slog sweep and it runs away from the deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Big turn there! More than Pakistan, India would love this as it could only get worse. Slower through the air outside off, Rohit lets it be. It turns and bounces away sharply.
This is hit through covers and Kohli takes a run.
Flatter and outside off, Rohit looks to cut but ends up chopping it towards short third man for one.
Well bowled! Sees Rohit come down and shortens the length. RS adjusts and cuts it to point.
Another single as Rohit punches it down to long on.
This is eased down to long on for one.
Flatter now on off, Sharma pushes it through covers for one.

In the air... but soft! Rohit did well to take one hand off. This is floated on off, Rohit looks to drive but the ball sticks on the surface. He takes one hand off the handle and hence, it lands well short of the fielder at extra cover.
Flatter and on middle, Kohli pushes it down to long on for one.
This is fired outside off, Kohli looks to run it down to third man but the ball hits the higher portion and then the middle and rolls towards point.
Imad Wasim is back! His figures read 7-0-33-0.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.

Very full on off, Kohli hits it wide of long off and takes two. The 50-run stand is up. This pair is building up on the good start provided by the opening wicket. They are going along at a good pace too.
The googly on middle, it is kept out.
Just short! This is fired outside off, Rohit slaps it uppishly but well short of the point fielder who misfields and a run is taken.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off. They pick up a single.
This is flatter and on off, Rohit pushes it down to long on.
Goes for a surprise short ball, Kohli is up for the challenge though. He pulls it over mid-wicket and takes two.
Rohit now plays it down to third man for one.
Slower one outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man for one.
Good length on off, Kohli guides it to point.
FOUR! You need not run for such shots! Outstanding. Not a very bad delivery, it is on a length and around off, Kohli stands tall and hits it on the up through covers.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

24th ODI HUNDRED FOR ROHIT SHARMA! Becomes the second Indian after Kohli to hit a ton against Pakistan in the ICC ODI World Cup. What a knock by the Hitman! He reaches there by cracking a short ball through cover-point for one. The Indian dressing room is on its feet. This is also the third fastest hundred by an Indian batsman versus Pakistan in ODIs. We all know, he doesn't sit back quiet after hitting a century, watch out Pakistan, here comes Rohit aiming for his fourth double hundred.
Moves to 99, Rohit! A delightful cover drive by Rohit and he returns for the second run.
Loopy and full on off, Kohli leans into the drive and chips his drive wide of the cover fielder for one.
Flatter and shorter again on off, it's stroked from the crease to sweeper cover for another single in this over.
Keeps a slip in place and bowls it short on off, Virat moves back and punches it down to long on for one.
Full and flighted outside off, Sharma drives it through covers and takes a single.
Shadab Khan is back on.
It remains that way! Full and outside off, Kohli shoulders arms to it.
Continues bowling it on a length and around off. VK defends it out. Just the run from the over so far.
Back of a length again on off, Kohli pushes it to mid off.
Almost does get Kohli. Amir angles this across Virat. Kohli looks to guide it down to third man but misses. A few words by Amir but Kohli does not respond.
Back of a length on off, it is kept out.
On the pads, this is worked towards fine leg for one. Moves onto 95.
Mohammad Amir is back! He was brilliant in his first spell. Can he get either of Rohit or Kohli here? That is probably why he has been brought back on.
Another easy run as Rohit taps it towards backward point.
Slower one but it comes out wrong. Way too wide outside off, left alone. Wided.
A little bit of width on this one outside off. Kohli guides it down to third man for one.
Extra bounce there! Wahab is bending his back. Back of a length on middle, it takes off after pitching. Hits Kohli on the glove as he tries to defend.
Good length on off, Kohli does well to defend it by taking one hand off the handle.
On the body, this is pulled towards fine leg for one.
This is angled into the batsman, Rohit works it to mid-wicket.

Excellent running! Length and around off, Kohli looks to drive with hard hands but it goes off the inner half towards square leg. They run the first one hard and then go for the second, complete it. Another expensive over by Hassan Ali. His second spell has gone for 19 and he has bowled only 2.
On the pads, this is worked towards fine leg for one.
Length again on off, Rohit guides it to point.
Good comeback! On a length and around off, Sharma goes back and defends it onto the ground.
SIX! Majestic shot! Into the 90s is Rohit Sharma. Short and wide outside off, Sharma slaps it right off the middle and the ball sails over the point fence.
Outside off, it is left alone.
Angled into the batsman, Kohli looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. A muted appeal from the bowler but he is the only one doing so.
Slower one on off, Rohit strokes it through covers for one.
Good running! Kohli taps it towards point and takes off straightaway. Rohit responds and a run is completed with ease. 150 up for India.
Back of a length on off, Rohit plays it late and down to third man for one.
Lovely shot! Just times it through covers and takes two. Nicely used the pace of the bowler there.
On middle, Rohit works it with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Kohli defends it onto the ground. Hassan Ali continues to be expensive.
Goes short! Kohli mistimes his pull but gets it through the vacant mid-wicket region for two.
Good length again around off, this is guided through backward point and towards third man for one.

FOUR! Fortunate one! Second time today he has got a boundary in that fashion against Hassan and the bowler can't believe his luck. Shorter and outside off, Rohit looks to guide it down to third man but the ball comes back in sharply. It hits the under edge and goes over the stumps and then to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, Kohli slaps it through covers for a run. Gets off the mark with a confident shot.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and way too wide outside off, Sharma looks to cut but misses. Wided.
Hassan Ali is back on. 3-0-27-0 so far.
Needles shot first up by Kohli. He goes after a very wide delivery. Ends up chopping it to point. End of a successful over for Pakistan.
Indian skipper Virat Kohli comes on at number 3, replacing Rahul. Is 57 short of becoming the fastest to 11,000 ODI runs.

OUT! Soft dismissal and Pakistan have finally got the much-needed wicket. It has come completely against the run of play though. A good ball from Wahab. It is just behind the driving length on off. Sticks in the wicket a little. Rahul looks to drive it through covers but ends up chipping it straight to Azam there. He makes no mistake and reverse cups it safely. Rahul will be disappointed as there was a century for the taking. But he played a handy role in the partnership worth 136 with Rohit. Pakistan will now look to pull things back under control.
Goes around the wicket and then lands it on a length around off, Rahul guides it to point.

Back of a length again on off, Rahul goes back and keeps it out. Wahab now gets an OFFICIAL WARNING for running onto the danger area. So Amir already has been given two and Wahab now has one. Worrying signs for Pakistan.
Back of a length on off, Rahul defends it onto the ground.
A bumper but it is a wild one! Way down the leg side, wided.
Length and outside off, Rohit plays it late down towards third man for one.
Wahab Riaz is back on! Just the one over for Malik.

Dangerously picks this from the off and middle stump, sweeping it fine but straight to short fine leg. Rahul wants a single but Rohit sends him back. Good call. That went very quickly to the fielder. 11 each from the opening overs of the 2 part-timers.

SIX! Oh wow. Rahul gets into the act now. Don't look like India are interested in the Professor's classes. Tossed up outside off, Rahul comes down the track and lofts it cleanly inside out over wide long off!
Around middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Comes down the track and drives it straight to short cover.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
FOUR! Good afternoon, Professor! What a welcome to the senior guy. Tossed up around middle, Rohit comes down the track and bashes this past Hafeez to the long on fence!
Here comes the Professor. Pakistan desperately need Hafeez to strut his experience.
Another single as Rohit works it through mid-wicket for one. Expensive start by Malik.
On middle, Rahul paddles it towards short fine leg for one.

SIX! Just clears the fence! Fifty for Rahul. He has ensured India don't miss Dhawan here. He went about things slowly but a good innings nevertheless. There is a ton on offer here. Rahul gets to his half ton in style. Sees the length is short, rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket region. It goes all the way.
Works it with the turn through square leg for one.
Shorter on middle, Rahul whips it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, Rohit keeps it out towards the off side and takes one.
Shoaib Malik is on now!
STAT ALERT! Whenever India's openers have put on a century stand in the ODI World Cup, their win percentage is 86 percent! (6 of 7 prior instances).
Good running! This is worked to the longer part of the ground towards square leg and the batters take two.
This is worked to the left of mid-wicket who dives over the ball and a run is taken.
Quicker and on off, Rahul strokes it through covers for one.
On off, it straightens. Takes the outside edge of Rohit's bat and rolls towards short third man for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Rahul slaps it through covers for one.
On the stumps, this is pushed down to long on for one.

Gets away with one there Shadab! Rahul gets into position early to play the reverse sweep. Shadab looks to fire it in but ends up bowling a full toss. Rahul plays the reverse but straight to backward point. A dot to end! Just the 6 from the last 3 overs.
Another dot as Rahul defends it towards point. He wanted a run but is sent back.
Flatter and on off, this is guided through point for an easy run.
A halt in play as Rohit needs to tie his shoe laces!
Very full outside off, Rohit initially looks to sweep but then seeing the length, jams it out to point.
Gets it to drift in from off and then turns it away. RS blocks it.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Imad ends it well too! Back-to-back tight overs for Pakistan. The last ball is pushed through covers for one.
On the stumps again, Rahul keeps it out. This is turning out to be another good over.
On off again and Rahul pushes it back from where it came.
Slower on off, Rahul guides it to point.
Beaten in flight this time, Rahul. He stays back to a full ball around off when he should have been forward but eventually does well to block it on the off side.
Shortish and on off, Rohit goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover.

Drinks break. It's all India at the moment! Apart from winning the toss, nothing has gone Pakistan's way. There were a few half chances but they have not taken them and the pair of Rohit and Rahul is just dominating proceedings at the moment. 18 overs done, Pakistan have used all their main bowlers but apart from Mohammad Amir and Imad Wasim, to an extent, all have struggled at the big stage. They need to regroup in this mini-break and come out with some different strategy. For India, it's all about maximizing this beginning.
A very good over by Shadab comes to an end. He ends with a slider on off which Rahul pushes to cover. Need a few more like these do Pakistan.
Another good delivery! The googly on off, Rahul defends it late onto the ground.
Flighted ball on off, Rohit strokes it through mid off for one.

Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one. The 100 is up for India. This is the first 100-run stand for the opening wicket against Pakistan in ICC ODI World Cups for India. The openers have provided the best possible start. Also, it has come up in very quick time. The foundation is laid here for a big score.
Lovely bowling! Slows it up and lands it on off, Rahul leans forward and keeps it out.
Slower through the air and outside off, left alone.
A single to end! 6 from the over. Rahul pushes it down to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, Rahul pushes it towards point.
Rahul feels he missed out there! Down the leg side, Rahul looks to sweep but misses. Wided. Had he connected, it would have been a boundary.
Works it with the angle, uppishly but wide of mid-wicket and down towards wide long on for the 4th single in the over.
Rahul opens the face of the bat at the very end and guides it through cover for one.
Another tossed up ball on off, Rohit this time eases it to long off for one.
On the fuller side, this is hit down to long off for one.
Another single as Rahul pushes it through covers for one. A good comeback by Shadab after going for a boundary on the very first ball.
The googly, Rohit picks it and works it down to long on for one.
Three good balls in a row! On off, Rohit blocks it.
Slower through the air outside off, Sharma looks to sweep but misses.
Better! Lands it on off and gets it to spin away. Rohit puts in a good stride forward and looks to defend with soft hands but it goes off the outer half towards backward point.
FOUR! Lovely placement! Shadab is struggling here. He has gone for 24 in the 13 balls he has bowled. Shorter and outside off, Rohit goes back and guides it past point for a boundary.
A dot to end a tidy over by Imad. Fires it on off, Rahul pushes it to covers.
A single now as Rohit eases it down to long off.
On off again, this is defended.
Good stop! This pitches on off and then straightens. Rahul looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards short third man where the fielder makes a good diving stop. A run only.
On off, Rohit strokes it through covers for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Around off and outside off, pushed towards point. 4 runs in the last two overs, good ones for Pakistan after a 17-run 12th over!
Struggling for control, bowls this too full, outside off, Rahul strokes it towards long off for a run.
Floated around off, watchfully kept out.
Tossed up outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.
Full on middle, Rahul drives it straight back. 'PAKAD!' yells Sarfaraz. Shadab dives to his right but misses the ball. A single taken towards long on.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Arrowed in on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Short in length, punched off the back foot for a single.
Quicker one outside off, Rahul looks to cut but misses.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, watchfully defended. 17 from the over! Have India got the kickstart they needed?

FOUR! Now the length is full and Rohit drives it behind point. Seems like there is no fielder out when India are batting. 43rd ODI Fifty for Rohit. 7th against Pakistan. 3rd 50-plus score on the trot for him in this World Cup. Looks good to get his second ton in this edition.

SIX! Oh dear. Bad, worse, worst nothing beyond the superlative. This is a horror start from Shadab. After bowling it short, he does not land this one at all. Rohit pulls it over mid-wicket for half a dozen.

More rubbish from Shadab. A plethora of half trackers from the leg spinner. Rohit picks the length in a trice and wallops the pull in the mid-wicket region. Almost gets a boundary but Hassan Ali runs to his right and stops the ball well. Two runs taken.
Another bad ball, short and wide outside off, cut through point for a single this time.
FOUR! Bad ball to start. Short and wide outside off, turning away, Rahul uses the width, goes deep in his crease and cuts it behind point for a boundary.
Shadab Khan into the attack now.
A dot to end! On off, Sharma keeps it out. 9 from the over, another productive one for India.

Wayward throw! Another run out opportunity missed! Rahul pushes this towards point and sets off. Rohit responds. Shadab is quick to the ball but releases a wild throw by diving across to his right, way too away from the keeper. Pakistan have not started well in the field. Maybe the nerves of such a big game has gotten to them. This is one example as Shadab is usually a brilliant fielder but he has messed up big time over here.
BEAUTY! That has straightened! This is pitched around leg, the ball straightens after pitching. Rahul looks to play it with a closed face of the bat but misses to get hit high on the pads.
On the pads again, this is worked towards short fine leg for one.

Well played again! Rahul uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He still manages to chip it over the mid-wicket fielder. They take two. Imam in the deep fumbles and an extra run is taken.
FOUR! Swept and swept nice and fine! Played that with the angle. It is fired in on the pads, Rahul goes down on one knee, uses the pace of the bowler and hits it to the fine leg fence.

POWERPLAY 2 time. Danger period for Pakistan. Neither opener has been dismissed. Just like Australia experienced against India, the Men In Green might be in line for some upswing in the run rate now. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

FOUR! Brings the 50 up for the team in style! Riaz bowls it shorter and outside off, Rohit plays it late and cuts it past point. No chance for third man. Once again the last ball spoils Wahab's over. India have dominated Powerplay 1. They are 53 for no loss after it.
Another confusion! This is worked towards mid-wicket and Rahul wants a run but Rohit sends him back.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Good length on off, it is guided to point.

A big, big confusion but no harm in the end! Pakistan should have had their first wicket. A huge miss there. Wahab bowls it on middle, Rahul works it through mid-wicket. They take one, Rohit wants the second and is sprinting to the other end. Rahul initially starts off but then shouts 'NO' with his hand up. Rohit does not spot that until he reaches halfway. Zaman in the deep, picks the ball up and in a rush, without looking, throws it to the bowler's end. Wahab fails to collect it. The fielder backing up does so. He then throws it to the keeper but Rohit is in by then. A big let off for India. Rohit would want to make them pay now. Sarfaraz as usual is not happy with his fielder. Fakhar should have shown more game awareness there.
A single to end! On the pads again, Imad continues to bowl a straighter line. Rahul flicks it through square leg for one. Just the four from the over, a tidy start by Imad.
Fires this into the pads, Rahul pushes it to mid-wicket.
Goes wide of the crease and attacks the middle stump. Rahul strokes it back to the bowler.
Another one on the pads, Rohit flicks it through square leg and rotates strike.
Flatter on the stumps, Rahul works it through square leg for one.
On the stumps, this is pushed back to the bowler.
False start for Imad as he bowls this one down the leg side. Rahul looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Imad Wasim is on now! Change from both ends for Pakistan.

FOUR! Just over! Wahab goes short and on the body, Rohit helps it on its way, hits it uppishly but just over the jumping short fine leg fielder and into the fence. Spoils the over, another good one for India.
A little fuller and on off, Rohit lunges and defends it onto the ground.
Another back of a length delivery, Rahul waits for it and then guides it down to third man for one.
Back of a length on off, Rahul stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Shorter in length and on middle, this one skids through. Rohit awkwardly pulls it towards square leg for one.
Starts off with a ball on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Wahab Riaz is on now! This change was on, Hassan Ali was not bowling that well.

A bye! Length and outside off, Rahul lets it be. This bounces just ahead of Ahmed who fails to stop it cleanly and a run is taken. A good over though from Amir. He is keeping it tight, Pakistan need the same from the other end.
Good delivery again! Length and on off, Rahul ends up playing outside the line, he gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
Good running! Rohit drops it towards the off side and takes off. The fielder does score a direct hit at the keeper's end but Rahul was well in.
Good length and just outside off, Rahul guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.

Just like you bat in partnerships, you bowl in partnerships as well. Amir is building pressure at one end while Hassan is releasing it at the other. Pakistan need pressure to be built from both ends. A bowling change might be seen soon.
Another good delivery! Around off and Amir gets it to slant away. Rahul leaves it alone.
Good length and outside off, it is left alone.

SIX! Stand and deliver! Trademark Rohit Sharma. Slightly shorter and on off, the key here was Rohit picks the length early. He just leans back a little and pulls it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence. A very good over for India, 12 from it.
Sarfaraz is happy with this though. Hassan lands it on a length and outside off, Rohit shoulders arms to it.

FOUR! Short, wide and smashed! Width on offer outside off and Rohit pounces onto it. He slaps it past the diving cover-point fielder and it races away to the fence. Sarfaraz is not happy with that line and rightly so.
Goes short this time and around off, Rahul gets on top of the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for one.

Amit - I know why Amir is continuously stepping on that danger area. Pakistan are fielding two spinners in their side today. By landing on those areas, Amir wants to create some footmarks which will assist his team's spinners. Well, Amit, Sarfaraz may not want to lose out Amir so early in this innings, just to help his spinners.
Back of a length and on middle, Rohit works it towards mid-wicket for one.
On a good length and around off, Rohit blocks it late.
Well bowled! Once again rolls his fingers on this delivery. It pitches and moves away. Rahul ends up playing inside the line and gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Rahul keeps it out.

On the fuller side outside off, Amir may have rolled his fingers on this delivery. Rahul shoulders arms to it. The umpire walks down to the middle of the wicket, has a look and then warns Amir for the SECOND TIME OFFICIALLY! Amir really needs to be careful, one more mistake and he can't bowl in this game.

Almost drags it on! Rahul gets carried away with the last boundary. He looks to smash this through the off side but goes too hard at it and also away from the body. He gets an inside edge past the leg pole and towards the keeper.

FOUR! Good shot! Rahul had no intentions to keep that down. It is short and on middle, Rahul is up for the challenge. He goes back and pulls it over the square leg fielder for a boundary. First for him.
Amir continues bowling it on a length and angles it away. Rahul leaves it alone.
Just as I write that, an unconvincing defensive shot. Length and around off, this one comes back in. Rohit looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Goes wide of the crease and then angles it on off, Rohit is solid in defense. So after the initial shaky start, Rohit now seems to be hitting the middle.

BEATEN! Rash shot! Shorter in length and outside off, Rohit looks to slash at it but there isn't much width on offer and he gets beaten. The ball also moves away after passing the bat. Sarfaraz has no problem to collect it though.

FOUR! Beats the diving mid off fielder and it races away! Lovely shot. It is just a mere push there. Fuller on off by Hassan. Rohit uses the pace and strokes it past the mid off fielder and it races away to the fence.
Perfect! On a length and around off, it is kept out.
A little too straight this time, Rahul works it down to fine leg for one. Hassan is bowling a little too straight. They have two slips in place and this is not the line he should be bowling.
A single to end! Rahul works it towards square leg and takes one. He too gets off the mark.
Angles this one away from the batter, Rahul shoulders arms to it. Watchful start by KL.
Back of a length on the pads, Rohit Sharma works it towards square leg and gets to the other end.

Good length and outside off, Sharma leaves it alone. Amir is warned OFFICIALLY for running onto the danger area. An early warning, he needs to be careful now. Sarfaraz is not happy about the early warning but the umpire says he did warn him before.
A bumper now with a lot of fizz. Sharma is beaten for pace as he looks to pull.

Caught in two minds here! Rohit is a little worried about the inswinger. He first looks to defend this ball around off but then seeing it angle away, tries to leave. Too late till then and Rohit gets a bottom edge to the keeper. It goes on the bounce.

Three to end a good second over for India. This is on the pads again, Rohit flicks it past square leg. The fielder gives it a chase and pulls it back before the ball crosses the ropes. Saves a run for his side.
First runs off the middle! On the pads, Rohit works it through square leg and takes two.
Hits the length hard and gets it to bounce nicely. Rohit stands tall and defends it onto the ground.

FOUR! Rohit and India are off the mark with a boundary! Streaky one but they won't care. Hassan Ali drags his length back and this one jags back in after pitching. Rohit looks to put bat on ball but the ball goes off the inner half, over the stumps and into the fine leg fence.
Just short! A loose shot. Fullish again and this one comes back in from outside off. Rohit looks to drive it with loose hands and it goes off the inner half towards the bowler. Doesn't carry.
Goes fuller in length but no movement on offer. Rohit strokes it to mid off.
Hassan Ali to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Third leave in a row! Outside off again and Rahul lets it be. A maiden to begin with by Amir. Good start for Pakistan.
Another one outside off, Rahul leaves it alone again.
This is wider outside off, Amir wants Rahul to play a loose shot early on. Rahul shoulders arms to it.
Well bowled! Amir goes full this time, gives the ball more opportunity to do its bit. It does tail back in and Rahul strokes it to mid on by getting his front leg out of the way.
Once again on a length and around off, no movement on the first two balls for Amir. Rahul is solid in defense once again.
Starts off right on the money! On a length and around off, angles this one away. Rahul shuffles across and keeps it out.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems! It is time for the action to get underway. Pakistan are in a huddle and now make their way out to the middle. A new opening pair for India as KL Rahul walks out with Rohit Sharma. The former will take strike and he will be facing Mohammad Amir who has the first new ball in hand. He is in excellent form in this tournament so far. Pakistan would love it if he strikes early. Two slips in place. Here we go...
Time for the National Anthems! The two teams make their way out to the middle. Pakistan will sing their first and then it will be India's turn.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma, KL Rahul, Virat Kohli (C), Vijay Shankar (IN FOR SHIKHAR DHAWAN), MS Dhoni (WK), Kedar Jadhav, Hardik Pandya, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Kuldeep Yadav, Yuzvendra Chahal, Jasprit Bumrah.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Imam-ul-Haq, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Mohammad Hafeez, Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK/C), Shoaib Malik, Imad Wasim (IN FOR ASIF ALI), Shadab Khan ( IN FOR SHAHEEN AFRIDI), Hassan Ali, Wahab Riaz, Mohammad Amir.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, says they would have bowled first as well, the conditions are pretty good for bowling at the moment but the wicket is good, looks a little dry though and he hopes the two wrist spinners can make use of it later on. States the team which holds its nerve will probably win the game and they are very focused. Informs they have a forced change as Shikhar Dhawan has to sit out due to an injury and Vijay Shankar comes in as he gives them a lot more balance.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed, says the overhead conditions should assist the bowlers early on and they would want to make use of it. Informs they have two spinners and both are quality spinners and can make a difference. Ends by saying India against Pakistan is a big game and they are focused on it.

TOSS - It is time for the flip of the coin. The two captains are out there. Virat Kohli has the coin in his hand, he tosses it, Sarfaraz Ahmed calls tails and it lands in his favor. PAKISTAN WILL BE BOWLING FIRST!

PITCH REPORT - Michael Clarke says the toss won't matter a lot. States it looks a good wicket, it is a little dry and there is a little moisture underneath the wicket as there was rain yesterday. Mentions it should be a good batting wicket but you have to get through the new balls. Ends by saying the weather might play a role in the decision taken by the captains during the toss as DLS could come in play.

WEATHER REPORT - How's the weather? Will it rain? Will we get a full game? Will it be a washout? These are the common questions being asked since the last couple of days. We cannot say anything about the future but it has not rained since morning. However, the skies are getting overcast. This is what the forecast suggests - 'A mainly dry and bright start, but showers will soon start to cross from the southwest. A mix of sunny spells and heavy showers will then prevail, the showers turning heavy and thundery at times.' Ouch. Fingers crossed.

The experienced guys on both sides will be quietly confident but there still will be butterflies in the stomach. Do Pakistan have a mental block against India in World Cups? Will their young guns be able to shake off that block without much burden on their shoulders? Same goes to India. Having beaten Pakistan 6 times in a row in World Cups, the seventh chapter cannot be something different for the Indian fans. That brings a separate amount of pressure. Who will wilt? Who will sustain? For our sake, let us be entertained!

For a statistician, this will be nothing more than another one-sided contest. In spite of Pakistan being the better side in the previous two decades, they have never defeated India in a World Cup. And now, with tides changed, the task seems even more improbable. But this is the same Pakistan unit which beat England a few days ago, shocking the world. That is how unpredictable they are. Take them lightly at your own peril.

The D-day is here. It is game number 22 of the tournament and on paper it is just a league game. JUST. But in reality, it is nothing less than a final, if not more. The tickets for this fixture were sold out very quickly as soon as the dates were announced and now, everyone is ready. Grab your colas, your popcorns or whatever source of eating or drinking and fasten your seat belts. It is India-Pakistan again.
